COD.note: Says aggregated RSU statistical directories are public but names no published statistics from administrative records.
Multifactor authentication is for staff access to the RSU, not a service for people proving identity.
No civil register to ID link stated.
No hosting or cloud policy stated; the RSU's own cloud hosting is a system, not a policy.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Social Affairs (MINAS) says the Registre Social Unique is a 100% sovereign system with national hosting of its data and full control of infrastructure and source code.

systems.platform: MIS-DRC web server and Android app

COD.note: Names a complaints mechanism (MGPR) with a toll-free number, not a web, app or messaging channel.
No national ID enrolment count; the 465,883 households are RSU registrations.
No national ID number used as a key by any register.
The unique identifier is the RSU's own, not a national ID system.
RSU team aims at ISO/IEC 27001 only, an aim for one system.
The RSU is a register of vulnerable households, not of the whole population.
No national standards body or standard stated.

facts.fact: MINAS says the RSU supplies lists of eligible households to partner social programmes under data-sharing protocols, and partner programmes return information on services received and changes to beneficiaries.
MINAS says the RSU provides eligible-household lists to the different social programmes, including State ones, after data-sharing protocols and a framework partnership agreement are signed.

COD.note: Describes a social registry's information system, not a programme's management system.

facts.fact: MINAS says the Registre Social Unique, created by Decree 25/041 of 4 December 2025, has a functional management information system (MIS-DRC) and registered about 465,883 households in 2020-2025, 267,015 of them in 2025.
MINAS says the RSU provides lists of eligible households to the different social programmes, including State ones, under data-sharing protocols.

systems.platform: MIS-DRC web server (cloud) and Android app
